channel.title: JLT Spotlight (Facebook)
channel.description: Weekly Cruise, Hotel & Destination of the Week from JLT Group

item.title: Two weeks from now, Sailing Club pre-registration opens for Virgin Voyages' first-ever Scandinavian season… 13 August, with general sale following on 14 August. Worth marking in the diary now. 📅
item.description:
Two weeks from now, Sailing Club pre-registration opens for Virgin Voyages' first-ever Scandinavian season… 13 August, with general sale following on 14 August. Worth marking in the diary now. 📅
Valiant Lady is homeporting in Amsterdam for Summer 2028: Norwegian Fjords, Arctic Circle routes, the Scandinavian capitals and 15 ports entirely new to the fleet. Adults-only, all-inclusive (food, drinks and WiFi), and Travel + Leisure's #1 Mega Cruise Ship 2025.
The client angle is a sharp one: couples and returning cruisers who want Nordic scenery without a family-focused ship. 🌍
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: Lapland in December is easy to get wrong.
item.description:
Lapland in December is easy to get wrong.
Most Lapland breaks funnel families into a busy resort town when what they were after was something quieter. The Aurora Winter Lodge in Lannavaara, Swedish Lapland, is a different proposition. ❄️
This is Transun's three-night Arctic break: full-board, flights, thermal suits, a full-length husky safari, snowmobile safari, and a working Sami reindeer camp visit.
December 2026 runs across five UK airports, one departure each, from £1,249pp for adults. 🎄 A £200pp deposit holds the date.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: The client for this one is the one who's said "Japan" to you more than once and never pulled the trigger. 🌏
item.description:
The client for this one is the one who's said "Japan" to you more than once and never pulled the trigger. 🌏
Silversea's Silver Muse does Tokyo to Tokyo in 12 days, calling at eight ports across Japan and South Korea. Mount Fuji views from Shimizu, Kyoto's temples via Kobe, Okinawa, volcanic Kagoshima.
Butler service in every suite. Nine restaurants. S.A.L.T. Kitchen menus built around the ports.
The culinary angle is your opening line with any food-led client. ✈️
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: Exclusive trade rates are live for Greater Fort Lauderdale. 🌊 Up to 25% off a mix of hotels, ready to book right now.
item.description:
Exclusive trade rates are live for Greater Fort Lauderdale. 🌊 Up to 25% off a mix of hotels, ready to book right now.
The pitch is a simple one: 24 miles of coastline, 300-plus miles of navigable waterways, and a city you can get around by water taxi. Same warmth as Miami, less of the crowd and the price tag.
It covers luxury couples, families combining Everglades days with beach time, and groups leaning into the waterfront dining scene. One destination, three completely different client briefs. Worth raising with any Florida enquiry on your books this week.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is the family who wants premium Spain without the all-inclusive catch. 🌍
item.description:
The client for this one is the family who wants premium Spain without the all-inclusive catch. 🌍
Ikos Andalusia in Estepona is one of our go-to answers for that brief. Multiple restaurants included, no speciality-dining upsell waiting at check-in. Free spa access for every adult, 8am to 8pm. Complimentary electric MINI hire and a five-mile coastal ride into Estepona town. Inspiring Travel Co has 10% off for travel through 18 September.
The Ikos Deluxe Collection villas here are, per Ikos's own portfolio literature, the largest across the whole group, with private pools. ✨ Worth raising with the right client this week.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is the couple who've done the Caribbean twice, ticked off the Med, and now want something they genuinely couldn't piece together on their own.
item.description:
The client for this one is the couple who've done the Caribbean twice, ticked off the Med, and now want something they genuinely couldn't piece together on their own. 🌏
Crystal Serenity's 16-night Asia sailing (April 2027, £9,399pp with flights included) covers six countries in one booking. Thailand, Vietnam, Brunei, Malaysia, the Philippines and Hong Kong, unpacking once.
The crew-to-guest ratio is close to one-to-one. That's the kind of detail that explains the "ultra-luxury" label without any overselling needed. ✈️
Worth flagging now. Early cabin categories are open, and inventory on a 770-guest ship moves.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: Aldabra Atoll sits so far out that most vessels cannot reach it. 🌊
item.description:
Aldabra Atoll sits so far out that most vessels cannot reach it. 🌊 Protected precisely because of that remoteness, it is home to an estimated 100,000+ giant tortoises and a UNESCO World Heritage Site few travellers ever see.
Aqua Expeditions built Aqua Lares, their new 77-metre superyacht, specifically for this territory. Icebreaker hull, 30 guests, 32 crew, inaugural sailings from 8 February 2026.
Itineraries from 5 nights (inner islands, from £7,100pp) to 9 nights out to Aldabra, with extensions to Zanzibar and Tanzania. 🧭 The practical note: individual cabins are bookable now, not charter-only. A couple can book without filling the whole ship. Exsus Travel handles trade bookings.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: £21 per person per night, fully refundable. 🌍
item.description:
£21 per person per night, fully refundable. 🌍
That's the B2B rate showing for X2 Vibe Bangkok Sukhumvit in November 2026, and it's worth a look beyond the headline number. The refundable piece is what makes it interesting for agents. November 2026 is a long way out... normally that means asking clients to commit non-refundable money to plans that might move.
This one lets you hold a well-connected Bangkok base at a mid-market price, then firm up the rest of the itinerary behind it. Balconies, BTS Skytrain on the doorstep, design-forward rooms at a budget that leaves room for the islands. ✈️ Ideal for the Thailand-curious client not yet ready to commit to everything at once.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: One for the Greece specialists... 🌊
item.description:
One for the Greece specialists... 🌊
When a client says "I want Santorini", what they mean is whitewashed villages, blue domes, turquoise water. Paros delivers every bit of that and adds something Santorini cannot: proper sandy beaches.
Kolympithres has granite boulders worn into natural swimming pools. Two hours from Santorini by ferry, with direct flights into Paros National Airport, and the prices are noticeably kinder.
Shoulder season is the pitch. May, June, and September give full swimming weather without the August crowds.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: One for the cruise specialists in here… 🛳️
item.description:
One for the cruise specialists in here… 🛳️
A Regent Seven Seas specialist called Harriet sailed Seven Seas Splendor Lisbon to Monte Carlo with her mother, seven nights, and wrote it up port by port. Not a brochure pass-on. Her own trip, her own words, including a sunset steak at Prime 7 she described as the best she has ever eaten, and dolphins spotted from the balcony off Tangier that her mother had waited a lifetime to see.
The detail that keeps coming up in her report is space. No queuing, no scramble for a lounger, always a pool spot and a table when you want one. That is the conversation to have with the experienced cruiser who is on the fence about trading up. ✨
Two Splendor sailings are bookable now: a 14-night Med in October 2027 (Lisbon to Rome) and an 11-night Canada and New England foliage sailing in September 2026. Match one to a client on your list this week.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: Worth knowing before 30 July. ⏳
item.description:
Worth knowing before 30 July. ⏳
The Exsus offer on Viceroy at Ombria runs out then: seven nights from £1,095pp with a complimentary night included and £100pp saved.
🌿 The property itself is worth knowing regardless. Not a beach hotel. Sits inland near Querenca, built to resemble a traditional Portuguese hill village on a 150-hectare estate.
Suites run to 173 sqm with kitchens or kitchenettes. There is an award-winning golf course, a dedicated spa and a dark-sky stargazing programme in a certified reserve.
This is the answer for the client who says Algarve but means somewhere quieter and more characterful.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is that well-travelled person who has done Beijing, Shanghai and Xi'an and comes back to you saying, "I want something different." 🌍
item.description:
The client for this one is that well-travelled person who has done Beijing, Shanghai and Xi'an and comes back to you saying, "I want something different." 🌍
Chongqing is the answer. Light rail running straight through a high-rise building, drone shows over the skyline at night, and underneath it all, a genuine hot-spring heritage tied to traditional Chinese medicine. Wendy Wu Tours has built a retreat around it: eight days from £3,990pp, with a qigong master, reflexology and a Miao Medicine Clinic visit on the itinerary… some of them exclusive to the operator.
The catch is there is only one departure: 9 May 2027. Early conversation is the one that secures the seat. 🗓
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is the family who has done Florida twice and is ready for a US Southwest change of pace. 🌵
item.description:
The client for this one is the family who has done Florida twice and is ready for a US Southwest change of pace. 🌵
Arizona checks more boxes than most agents realise. Tucson's guest ranches give multi-gen families riding, hiking and Saguaro National Park scenery, while Scottsdale handles the luxury end with serious spa and resort credentials. One state, three or four distinct experiences, and a daily BA service into Phoenix.
Visit Arizona has a live agent webinar this Tuesday 7 July at 11am BST, with a £50 shopping voucher prize draw on the call. Worth blocking an hour while the autumn booking window is open.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is clear the moment you read it… HNW, sporting, multi-generational, or anyone circling a September or October Scottish escape. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
item.description:
The client for this one is clear the moment you read it… HNW, sporting, multi-generational, or anyone circling a September or October Scottish escape. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
Gleneagles has a senior ghillie who designed and hand-ties the estate's own salmon fly, the Gleneagles Glory, drawing its colours from the hotel's interior. Every guest on a fishing trip leaves with one. That kind of depth is not something a newer property can manufacture, and it is exactly what your client is paying for.
Three championship golf courses, a Michelin two-star restaurant (the only one in Scotland at publication), a gundog school, a riding school… the whole party can be busy on the same estate, on the same stay. ✨
The autumn calendar still has room. Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: One for the expedition specialists in the group 🧭
item.description:
One for the expedition specialists in the group 🧭
Aurora Expeditions has turned 35 and they're marking it with a campaign built to move enquiries this week. The campaign runs to the end of September and pairs up to 30% off Antarctica 26/27 and Arctic 27 voyages with up to £2,600 air credit applied as an additional voyage discount. That long-haul flight cost to Ushuaia is usually the thing that makes a considering-it client hesitate. This takes it off the table.
The ships are the Greg Mortimer and Sylvia Earle. Small expedition vessels with X-Bow hulls 🌊 that cut through the Drake Passage rather than ride over it. Around 130 to 160 guests. Real Zodiac time, ice camping, citizen science tie-ins. This is not a mainstream brand with a polar add-on.
Pull your expedition enquiry list this week and match names to voyages before September closes.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: One for the long-haul winter-sun specialists… TUI has announced the only nonstop UK flights to Zanzibar, departing from Gatwick from 3 November 2027. Twice weekly, Wednesdays and Sundays, through to 22 March 2028. 🌊
item.description: One for the long-haul winter-sun specialists… TUI has announced the only nonstop UK flights to Zanzibar, departing from Gatwick from 3 November 2027. Twice weekly, Wednesdays and Sundays, through to 22 March 2028. 🌊 The connection has been the sticking point for years. That is now gone. Direct from Gatwick changes the conversation entirely, especially for clients who have been curious about the Spice Island but baulked at the journey. Lead-in prices start from £1,615 per person (two adults, all-inclusive, seven nights including flights and transfers). The Winter 2027 programme goes on sale 2 July 2026. Worth having your shortlist ready before that date. ✈️ Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: One for the back pocket, this week's Hotel Spotlight… 🏨
item.description: One for the back pocket, this week's Hotel Spotlight… 🏨 Bodrum Loft is the hotel for the client who wants Bodrum's glamour without the noise. Picture a little white village of minimalist villas stepping down a pine hillside to a private Aegean cove, barefoot beach-club mood, and a sea view from nearly every room. It is the calmer side of the peninsula… thirtysomething couples, Istanbul families, a sleepy bay, and a genuinely good table with Paper Moon right over the water. Villa kitchens make it a strong one for longer stays and honeymoons too. ✈️ Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: One for the luxury specialists in our community… 🚢
item.description: One for the luxury specialists in our community… 🚢 Silversea has opened a savings window worth knowing about this week. Up to 45 per cent off select voyages across all seven continents, and it closes on 30 June. That hard date is the point. It gives you a clear, premium reason to pick up the phone to your established luxury clients this week rather than waiting for them to come to you. A few autumn 2026 sailings worth flagging: Greek Isles and Istanbul from £3,550 pp on Silver Ray, and two overlapping Greek Isles departures on Silver Nova and Silver Spirit from £3,750–£3,850 pp. Good comparison material if a client is weighing itinerary over ship. ✈️ Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: ✈️ Regent Seven Seas is running Seven Seas Grandeur on a ten-night Mexican Riviera sailing, and the detail worth knowing is the excursion model.
item.description:
✈️ Regent Seven Seas is running Seven Seas Grandeur on a ten-night Mexican Riviera sailing, and the detail worth knowing is the excursion model.
Up to 42 shore excursions bundled into the fare 🌍, not sold on top at the gangway. That's the Regent Seven Seas model, and it's why Seven Seas Grandeur's Mexican Riviera sailing is worth flagging this week.
Ten nights, round-trip Los Angeles, departing 14 January 2027. Cabo San Lucas, La Paz, Mazatlán, Manzanillo, Puerto Vallarta… all from one unpacked suite. Mid-January also drops you into grey-whale season off Baja, which adds real value to the Cabo and La Paz stops.
Lead fares from £3,529pp, savings up to 35%. Booking window closes 30 September 2026.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬

item.title: The client for this one is easy to picture. Majestic Mirage Costa Mujeres opened in 2026 as an all-suite, adults-only, all-inclusive resort, beachfront north of Cancún 🌍. Every room is a suite. Not an upgrade tier, not an add-on… the actual standard. For honeymoon and anniversary couples who want space, privacy, and somewhere new, this is a clean match. Nobody in their circle has been there yet. That's your opening. Part of the Majestic Resorts family with a long Punta Cana track record behind it. Worth knowing now, before the reviews pile up and everyone's recommending it.

item.title: Sri Lanka is often described as having some of the highest leopard densities in the world. 🐆 Which means a realistic shot at a leopard on safari… not a hopeful one.
item.description:
Sri Lanka is often described as having some of the highest leopard densities in the world. 🐆 Which means a realistic shot at a leopard on safari… not a hopeful one.
That alone puts it on the radar, but the fuller picture is how much variety fits inside one itinerary. Safari in the dry southeast, tea-country bungalows in the cool hills, coastal resorts on the south coast. Three distinct client-fits, one destination. 🌿
The timing splits across two monsoon systems, so map that before you price anything this week.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 💬
